result.instructions: Control the already-running desktop with two complementary tools. AX is app-scoped semantic observation and action; GUI is full-desktop visual observation and absolute-pixel input. Use AX for named controls and GUI for pixels or content absent from the accessibility tree. AX find uses explicit equals/contains fields. Copy returned rN/wN refs exactly; never invent placeholders. A targeted ref owns its app and window, so omit app, app_ref and window_ref. Use window_ref only when every action is untargeted keyboard input. Batch only actions valid in one UI generation; split after likely dialog, window or navigation changes. Window activate/close uses wN and close must be last. AX action acceptance and visual change are evidence, not proof of task success; AX cannot prove files, persistence, network state or pixels. GUI keyboard/text uses current focus. AX keyboard/pointer fallbacks use global desktop focus, not background input. After GUI mutation, refresh AX before reusing semantic state. AX target-window screenshot coordinates are never GUI coordinates; GUI coordinates use the exact delivered full-desktop image.

tools.description: Semantic observe/find/act/assert_ax. Observe/find issue refs; act consumes refs only. Reads use app, app_ref, or window_ref; continue find with fN. Act returns current diff/tree/lifecycle; reread only if required. Use batch or action postconditions for known results. Element actions require rN, window actions require wN; act never accepts app, selector, or index. Targeted act rejects app_ref/window_ref; refs own both. Never invent refs. One wN per batch; targetless batches require window_ref. Stale refs never rebind. Working output may hide controls; find searches canonical AX records. Refs resolve live per action; continuity failure stops the batch. Batch known same-window steps. Split before window changes or unknown next targets. AX proves only AX-visible facts, not pixels/files/persistence/task completion. Limits: 32 actions, 20000 text chars.

focused.description: Return a bounded local subtree around the current focused element.

query.description: Bounded AX lookup. Supply at least one explicit filter; filters are ANDed and case-insensitive.

text_contains.description: Substring across name, description, value, or placeholder.

text_equals.description: Exact match against one text-bearing field.

cursor.description: Continue the exact prior find observation.

limit.description: Maximum matches in this page. Defaults to 20.

actions.description: Ordered same-window actions; maximum 32. Batch known steps; split on unknown results. Guard a dependent next action with the earlier action's postcondition.

type.description: Activate one uniquely bound top-level window.
Close one uniquely bound top-level window; this must be the final action.

observe.description: ACT ONLY: none|diff|screenshot; tree/full are invalid. Omit for a fresh post-action diff. A bounded refresh may return a working tree or lifecycle proof; reread only if required.

postcondition.description: Poll one final AX predicate until pass or timeout, then sample the selected observation. Prefer this to a separate assert_ax.

tools.name: AX

tools.description: Full-desktop ComputerAction batch; screenshot alone observes. Batch validates before input and returns one final screenshot. Coordinates are delivered-image pixels. AX activates/closes windows. type/keypress use current focus. wait is one second, no observation, max 20s/batch. scroll_x/scroll_y are Computer deltas. settle_ms checks visual stillness, not semantic success; omitted default 800ms, max 3000ms.

inputSchema.description: One screenshot action observes; otherwise run an input batch.

type.description: Capture the final full desktop; this must be the only action.

x.description: X pixel in the exact returned full-desktop image

y.description: Y pixel in the exact returned full-desktop image

type.description: Wait exactly one second without an intermediate observation; do not stack waits.

settle_ms.description: Visual stillness: default 800ms, max 3000ms. Final screenshot stillness, not extra sleep. After wait, usually omit it. At the cap inspect the screenshot or use AX assert_ax.

cli.--help:
Computer Use for Linux

Usage:
  computer-use [command] [options]

Commands:
  mcp                  Start the stdio MCP server.
  doctor               Print Linux runtime notes.
  call <AX|GUI>         Call one public tool, or run a JSON array of calls.
  help [command]       Show general or command-specific help.
  version              Print the CLI version.

Notes:
  The Linux runtime uses AT-SPI2 semantic actions first, then best-effort
  coordinate/key synthesis. Run it in the signed-in desktop session.
cli.help call:
Usage:
  computer-use call <AX|GUI> [--args '<json-object>']
  computer-use call --calls '<json-array>'

Only the public AX and GUI tools are accepted.
